cases.name: Elizabeth Sheeler
cases.about: She was a retired nurse and widow and lived alone in a basement apartment.
cases.narrative:
Her body was found lying on the bedroom floor with her legs spread. Her housecoat was open and bunched up under the middle of her back. Her panties were torn and cut in the crotch area and rolled up underneath her breasts. Presumptive testing of an oral swab taken from Sheeler showed the presence of semen.

Sheeler’s face had been battered, and her neck and chest area had numerous sharp-instrument wounds. Her dentures were found underneath the bed. 

Sheeler suffered blunt-force injuries to her face and 11 sharp wounds to her chin, neck, and upper chest area.

cases.name: Kelly Denise Barber
cases.about: Kelly was a music-lover who played and composed music for the guitar. She was an outgoing woman who could always be counted on to help anyone who asked her, whether they needed food, a place to stay, or someone to go sing karaoke with them. She also liked to spend time with her grandchildren. When she met the man who killed her, she was a widow who had lost her first husband eleven years previously.

cases.name: Debra J. Perrine
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Debra was a 1973 graduate of Fredericktown High School and earned her Associates Degree in Nursing from COTC. Debra worked in the radiology department at Knox Community Hospital and Mount Vernon Developmental Center. She enjoyed spending time with friends and family."
cases.relationship: Son / stepson / partner's son / child's partner
cases.narrative: On 12/29/2022 during a welfare check, her body was found buried under a blanket in the backyard of the home. Investigators determined Debra was likely struck in the head with a Playstation, which they found in a fire pit, with pieces found in the living room. Evidence of blood in the home suggested Debra fled from her son to her bedroom, where she was repeatedly stabbed to death in her bed.  She suffered blunt force trauma to her head and 14 stab wounds to her face, neck and upper chest. Prosecutors said said David attacked his mother late on Dec. 17 or early on Dec. 18, using a PlayStation 5 game to bash his mother's in the head, then picking up a knife to stab her 14 times.

cases.name: Tala Cheyenne Smith
cases.about:
Smith's father, David Tolbert, told ABC 6 over the weekend that their family is devastated.

"Talabama was our nickname for her," he said. "It is the worst day of our lives so far. We lost our sweet girl last night at 6:19 p.m. We were able to donate her organs to save others' lives. What we have been told so far is that at least four people would be saved from this horrific situation. Tala was a very outgoing person. Her passion was drawing, and she loved her cat and Pokemon."

Her obituary said, "Tala worked as a laundry mat attendant at Big Kahuna Ozone Laundry. She had many hobbies and interests, including drawing, reading, music, pokemon, gaming, cats and spending time outdoors. She loved J.R.O.T.C. Tala graduated as a junior from Newark High School. She was proud to be a big sister to her little brother. Tala will be remembered for her ability to help anyone without prejudice."
